israel.title: Flag of Israel

colors.note: Inspired by the tallit prayer shawl

desc: - A white field with two horizontal blue stripes near the edges and a blue Star of David at the centre
- The design was inspired by the tallit prayer shawl worn in Jewish religious ceremonies
trivia:
- The blue stripes are said to represent the stripes of a tallith (Jewish prayer shawl)
- The Star of David (Magen David) has six points and represents Jewish identity and the Jewish people
- The flag was designed by David Wolfsohn in 1891, decades before Israel's statehood in 1948
